$comment: Reference readings, so a score has something to be read against. dga.gov.sa is the publisher's own site: useful context and explicitly NOT a definition of compliance — the band always comes from the absolute score against the ledger. Generated by scripts/benchmark.mjs from a real verdict; never hand-typed, because a hand-typed reference is a number nobody can reproduce. `notMeasured` and `caveats` travel with each entry so a comparison is only ever drawn where both sides actually measured the check.

sites.label: dga.gov.sa/ar — the publisher's own site
caveats: A3 has no reading: the in-app browser never holds window focus, so :focus-visible cannot be observed
P2 excludes component states for the same reason — it measures size/type conformance only
C3 withdrawn: the semantic-context measure resolved every hit to a single page-level wrapper, so it proved nothing
Captured by resize without an intervening reload, so load-time responsive gates did not re-run at 375px
